newsitem.title: USA: Rep Roukema wants Bankers Trust merger hearing.
newsitem.headline: Rep Roukema wants Bankers Trust merger hearing.

text.p: Rep Marge Roukema, chairwoman of the House Banking Committee's Financial Institutions subcommittee, said Monday that Congress should hold a hearing on the implications of Bankers Trust New York Corp's acquisition of Alex. Brown Inc.

"This is indisputable evidence of why Congress must move quickly on financial modernization," the New Jersey Republican said in a statement. "If these mergers take place on a piecemeal, case-by-case basis before proper regulation is in place, safety and soundness could be threatened."

"I am therefore urging the Banking Committee to expedite procedures to bring landmark reform legislation before the full committee," Roukema said. "I am making an urgent request to the chairman for a hearing on the Alex. Brown/Bankers Trust acquisition in my subcommittee."

The hearing would explore the implications on various bank reform proposals of the $1.7 billion merger of Bankers Trust, seventh-largest bank in the country by assets, with Alex. Brown, a regional securities firm based in Baltimore, Maryland, a staffer for Roukema said.
Roukema has introduced a bill that would allow banks to combine with other financial service companies, including securities firms and insurance companies.
